recipe.visualDefinition: A clean studio portrait of three men in modern casual-rock attire, positioned against a solid pale yellow backdrop with a centered, two-tiered typographic overlay using high-contrast condensed fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via warm yellow vs cool blue/black clothing
Text-to-subject layering where typography sits in front of the mid-sections
Triangular composition with the central figure slightly forward
coreInvariants: Soft studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men framed from the waist up, filling the horizontal width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the blue leather jacket acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move down to the large white text, then scan the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space at the top above the heads and at the bottom corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale yellow (background) providing a warm, neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and blacks (clothing) creating a strong silhouette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with medium-to-low value subjects; text uses maximum brightness for legibility.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm yellows, cool blues, and neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same font family or similar condensed sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, condensed, all-caps impact of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display role.
Offers a professional, modern feel for the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three men in their 40s with modern hairstyles, wearing blue leather and denim jackets, standing against a solid pale yellow seamless background. The lighting should be even and soft.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text in the middle of the frame. The top line should be large, white, and in an extra-condensed bold sans-serif. The bottom line should be smaller, in a muted gold color, with wider letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Background is a flat, non-distracting yellow
Typography is legible against the clothing textures

mustRedesign: Original band name and album title text
Any specific brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the faces
Check that the yellow background is consistent and seamless
Verify the all-caps styling is maintained
Confirm the color palette remains within warm yellow and cool blue tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Warm Background + Centered Condensed Sans-Serif Overlay
